newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African Board sells 26,526 t maize domestically.
newsitem.headline: S.African Board sells 26,526 t maize domestically.

text.p: South Africa's Maize Board said on Thursday it had sold 26,526 tonnes of yellow maize for domestic use.
It said it sold 25,000 tonnes of maize to Meadowfoods at 780 rand a tonne, 1,350 tonnes at 800 rand a tonne to Bulkop Feeds and 176 tonnes at 805 rand a tonne to Langeberg Millers.
The tender, which closed on November 21, was for 30,000 tonnes of yellow maize for domestic use or export during December.
